notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: לבב em i bel bilong tingting na laik, i no hat

notes.subject: i sot olsem kaikai i sot
notes.rationale: יתחמץ tok bilong kaikai i go sot (fermented); hia em i tok bilong bel — pasin bilong bel i go narakain

notes.subject: אשתונן
notes.rationale: סון/שנן 'sutim/holim pen' — ol tanim tok i tok 'pricked in my reins'; mi tok 'i pen tru'

translation: Bikos bel bilong mi i sot olsem kaikai i sot, na nil bilong mi i pen tru.

tokens.gloss: i sot olsem kaikai i sot
